character.name: Alice
character.title: Simon's wife
character.origin: A terraced house a few streets from the sea, on England's south coast

witchlight.recovery: A night's sleep, or a quiet hour with the cats

powers.name: Point and Wish
powers.description: Point a finger and nudge the world a little: float a key across a room, flick a lock open, light a lamp, tidy a mess. Small things only, and they don't always land quite where she meant.

powers.name: Rhyme Spells
powers.description: A rhyme from her aunts' book keeps turning up in her head, uninvited.

powers.name: Glamour
powers.description: In shop windows, just for a moment, she sometimes catches a different face.

powers.name: Mirror Sight
powers.description: Mirrors sometimes seem to hold on to a moment a little too long.

powers.name: Touchstone
powers.description: Some things feel warm, or cold, as if someone has only just let go of them.

powers.name: Cat's Eyes
powers.description: Close her eyes and see, for a few minutes, through Saskee's or Suki's. The cats go where Alice can't, and they always find their way back to her.

powers.name: Witch's Sight
powers.description: Since the night Simon vanished, Alice notices what's hidden by magic: glamours, wards, and doors other people walk straight past.

powers.name: Sharp Eye
powers.description: When numbers, times or stories don't add up, Alice feels it before she can say why.

powers.name: Stop the clock
powers.description: Once, when a glass slipped from her hand, it hung in the air for a heartbeat before it fell.

powers.name: Cats who talk back
powers.description: Lately Suki looks at her as if she has a great deal to say.

powers.name: The name that answers
powers.description: Something stirs whenever a stranger says Simon's name.

case.title: The disappearance of Simon
case.summary: Simon is gone. His coat, shoes, keys and phone are all still here, his tea is still warm, and the house is empty. A few weeks ago he hung an old paper lantern from the beach in his study window, and he's been hearing singing at night ever since.
questions: Where is Simon? He left without his coat, shoes, keys or phone.
Where did the lantern come from, and who is singing?
What did Aunt Prue know about lanterns that come over the water?
Where is Bar Kurage, and why does Simon's coat have its matchbook?
Why is the lantern singing Simon's name?
Who took Simon through a mirror, and where does the cold light lead?
What does it mean to 'keep the light' in Yūgure?
Why are the lanterns of Yūgure turning cold and white?

clues.title: The lantern from the beach
clues.text: After the storm, Simon found an old paper lantern in the shingle, dry as a bone, printed with characters neither of them can read. He hung it in his study window.

clues.title: Singing in the night
clues.text: Since the lantern came, Simon has slept badly. He says he hears a woman singing in the study late at night, and once joked that the lantern had lit itself.

clues.title: Still-warm tea
clues.text: Simon's study: his chair pushed back, his tea still warm in his green frog mug, his phone face down beside it. No sign of a struggle. Every room in the house is empty.

clues.title: A line he never typed
clues.text: On Simon's laptop, one line of curling characters repeats down the screen, top to bottom, and keeps adding more. They look like the writing on the lantern.

clues.title: Aunt Prue's letter
clues.text: Tucked in a box in the loft: 'If a lantern ever comes to your window over the water, it is not a gift, it is a summons. Don't let anyone answer it who isn't ready to go. Ring me.' Signed Prue, with a phone number.

clues.title: A matchbook from nowhere
clues.text: In Simon's coat pocket: a matchbook printed with a glowing jellyfish and 'Bar Kurage, 3rd Canal Street, Yūgure'. Alice has never heard of the place, and Simon never smoked.

clues.title: Simon's phone
clues.text: His passcode is Alice's birthday. Nothing to hide in his messages. His searches and notes show weeks of trying to explain the lantern: a photo of a star-in-a-circle mark on its base, 'sleep paralysis singing', 'paper lantern writing'. A note from 4 a.m.: the woman sings the same few lines and 'sounds like she's waiting'. At 7:36 tonight he started a text to Alice and never sent it: 'I think I know what she's singing. It's my name.'

clues.title: The line is a song, written down
clues.text: Aunt Prue, hearing it described: the characters stack into a lantern because it's a calling-song, written so a lantern can read it back. A lantern calls whoever it has chosen by name. Prue says phones won't work on the other side of the door.

clues.title: The lantern sings Simon's name
clues.text: When the lantern in the study window glowed, Alice heard a woman's voice sing three low lines, and in the middle of them, Simon's name.

clues.title: The singing woman, Oharu
clues.text: Lit with a Bar Kurage match, the lantern shows a woman in a faded blue kimono, hair wet, standing in the study window glass. She calls herself Oharu. She sang Simon home, but he never arrived. 'A cold light took him, and it came from a mirror.'

clues.title: Why Simon
clues.text: Oharu says the lantern was sent over the water to find someone who will 'keep the light' for a city called Yūgure, and that it chose Simon. She was meant to sing him home along the lantern road. She doesn't know who took him, only that he is alive, far away and cold.

clues.title: The cold white lanterns
clues.text: Here and there in Yūgure, one lantern burns a cold white among the gold ones. A pharmacist on 3rd Canal Street says they began a month ago, creeping in from the outer districts, 'where the dusk is thinning'. People don't like to touch them.

clues.title: Simon's scent at the canal
clues.text: Through Saskee's eyes: a faint trail of Simon (coffee, soap, a warm laptop) on the canal steps by the bridge, a few doors from Bar Kurage. Through Suki's: odd customers going into the bar, some of them casting no shadows.
clues.source: Saskee and Suki, through Cat's Eyes

clues.title: Ume is lying
clues.text: Mama Ume says she's never heard of Simon, but her eyes went to the curtained back room, her hand went to her tattoo, and she's frightened. A thread of grey wool, the kind of sock Simon wears, is caught on the curtain rail.

people.name: Simon
people.role: Alice's husband, software developer, early forties
people.notes: Gone from the house without his coat, shoes, keys or phone.

people.name: Aunt Prue
people.role: Alice's aunt, the last of the family witches
people.notes: Answered after nine rings. 'So it's come, then.' Knows about lanterns from over the water, won't say everything on the phone. Her number: 01637 555 0142.

people.name: Oharu
people.role: The woman who sings in the lantern
people.notes: A ghost in a faded blue kimono, wet hair, carrying a twin of the study lantern. The lantern's voice: she was meant to sing Simon home. Wants to find him.

people.name: Mrs Nakagawa
people.notes: Brisk and wary. Hung up a lantern she says she didn't light.

people.name: Mama Ume
people.notes: Old woman with a jellyfish tattoo. Knew Alice's aunts. Says she's never heard of Simon, but she is lying and she is scared. Her eyes keep going to the curtained back room.

places.name: Home
places.notes: A terraced house a few streets from the sea. Where Simon was last seen.

places.name: Bar Kurage
places.notes: 3rd Canal Street, under the elevated line, by the stone bridge. A boathouse bar with a glowing jellyfish tank, run by Mama Ume. A curtained door at the back.

places.name: The Old Shrine Hill
places.notes: Where Oharu says the lantern road should have taken Simon, in Yūgure.

places.name: Yūgure
places.notes: The city on the other side of the garden door. A back alley, rain, neon, a long way from the south coast.

items.name: Hand mirror
items.notes: Her grandmother's, silver-backed. Her favourite for Mirror Sight.

items.name: Simon's reading glasses
items.notes: Something of his to hold when she looks for him.

items.name: Her aunts' spell book
items.notes: Given to her at 19 for the powers that never came. Mostly rhymes, recipes and warnings in the margins.

items.name: Mobile phone
items.notes: Aunt Prue's number saved in it.

items.name: Cricket bat
items.notes: Simon's, from the cupboard under the stairs. Lightly chewed by a cat.

items.name: The beach lantern
items.notes: Simon's lantern from the beach. Oharu goes wherever it goes. Keep it lit and level.

world.weather: Steady rain, neon in the puddles

companions.name: Saskee
companions.notes: Friendly boy, a bit of a scaredy-cat. Adores Simon.
companions.status: Riding in the satchel, nose out

companions.name: Suki
companions.notes: Couldn't care less about anything. Adores Simon; Alice will do.
companions.status: On a bar stool, ignoring everyone

companions.name: Oharu
companions.notes: A gentle ghost in a faded blue kimono who sings for the lantern. She comes wherever Alice carries it.

last_log: Pressed hard, Ume shuts like a door. Something in the jellyfish tank is watching them both.
